\vspace{2mm}

\normalsize 
Bioinformatician with training in Molecular Genetics and Biotechnology and over 5 years of experience in omics data analysis, mainly transcriptomics and epigenomics. I am currently interested in regulation of gene expression. Outside of academia, I have participated in several scientific outreach events. On the other hand, I have practiced rowing at international level, which has given me the opportunity to apply the values acquired during training and competition, such as teamwork and perseverance, to my personal and professional life.

\normalsize
